model_notes.caveat: 88 of 133 players matched to a real anytime-TD price this run (88 from live API; unmatched players show usage/model only, either no line posted for that player or a name-matching miss). 4 of 133 players clear the blueprint's qualification screen (Tier A/B). Screen implements the PDF's stated snap share/TD projection/red-zone role/regression checks and edge/EV tiers; matchup rating is implemented but informational only (see README); HEAT-window thresholds are named in the PDF but not formulaically defined, so not enforced. Candidate pool is last season's active players corrected for known offseason trades; true rookies and any very recent retirements the crosswalk hasn't caught are not included yet.
